newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pechiney rises on broker upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Pechiney rises on broker upgrade.

text.p: Shares in metals group Pechiney rose on Friday after broker SGE Delahaye upgraded the stock to "outperform" from "neutral," citing strength in aluminium prices and the dollar.
Fund managers said the broker also revised upward its EPS forecast to 12 francs per share from 11.60 for 1997 and to 22.80 from 22.20 for 1998.

The share price was up 0.82 percent at 271.10 francs at 1114 GMT, with 116,175 shares traded. Pechiney rose five percent on Thursday after another French broker, Cheuvreux de Virieu, upgraded the stock to a "buy" (2) from a "sell" (3) with a target price at 400 francs.
